data.name: Dotz Nano
data.description: Dotz Nano (ASX: DTZ) is an Israeli-Australian nanomaterials and specialty chemistry company with two main product lines: DotzShield (in-product tagging for oil & gas corrosion monitoring) and DotzEarth (nano-porous and polymer-based solid sorbents for DAC and point-source carbon capture). They supply sorbent material to DAC developers — including a 2025 MoU with CarbonCapture Inc. — rather than operating capture plants themselves.
